title: 3 AM
caption: Night shift, empty office, everyone he knows asleep. The founder tells Karan's story.
linkedin_text:
Night shift workers see the city when it is quiet and rarely get to talk about it.

Waypoint's Explore shows what people are saying tonight, by theme, so a person can read first and post one true sentence when they are ready. The founder character tells Karan's story; every screen is the real app.

cast.karan: Karan, an Indian man in his late twenties with short hair and stubble, a black t-shirt and a lanyard around his neck

scenes.clip: the founder, a young Indian man with a short beard in a black-and-white floral shirt and khaki shorts, facing the camera at a roadside tea stall at night, steam rising from a glass of tea, warm string lights, a gentle smile.
scenes.vo: Hi. This is Karan's story. He works nights. Most people he knows are asleep.
scenes.sub: Hi. This is Karan's story. He works nights. Most people he knows are asleep.
scenes.title: 3 AM

scenes.clip: {karan} at a desk in a large empty office at three in the morning, one monitor glowing, rows of dark desks behind him, a paper cup of tea beside the keyboard.
scenes.vo: At three in the morning the office is quiet. His phone is the only thing that talks to him.
scenes.sub: At three in the morning the office is quiet. His phone is the only thing that talks to him.

scenes.clip: {karan} standing outside the office at a tea stall at night, scrolling his phone, a few motorbikes passing behind, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: On Waypoint there is Explore. He picks a theme and reads what people wrote tonight.
scenes.sub: On Waypoint there is Explore. He picks a theme and reads what people wrote tonight.

scenes.clip: {karan} reading his phone on a bench at night with a small smile, city lights glowing in the distance, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: Same hour, other cities. Someone in Pune, someone in Lagos, awake like him.
scenes.sub: Same hour, other cities. Someone in Pune, someone in Lagos, awake like him.

scenes.clip: {karan} typing slowly on his phone at his desk at night, a thoughtful look, the empty office behind him, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: Then he writes his own. One true sentence. That is all it asks.
scenes.sub: Then he writes his own. One true sentence. That is all it asks.

scenes.clip: {karan} walking out of the office building at sunrise, golden light on the street, bag on one shoulder, a slow relaxed smile.
scenes.vo: Morning comes. The sentence is out there, and the walk home feels lighter.
scenes.sub: Morning comes. The sentence is out there, and the walk home feels lighter.
